scope: Read-only architecture assessment through softwarev6. Softwarev7 result pending. No RTL edits or physical compilation.
recommendation: Ifv7 gives no measured warm-frame improvement, retain the qualified baseline and do not fit or promote BIM2 merely because transport and ownership are correct.
already_offloaded_in_baseline: Raw vertex transform, reciprocal, and supported lighting through LOAD engine.
direct_import_removes_for_accepted_suppo: CPU UV offset/bias arithmetic and fixedpoint conversion.
CPU clip X/Y/W and depth fixedpoint conversions, RGB565 packing, prepared-payload stores.
Nine-word0x56 load packets are replaced with three-word0x5E references, plus six words of shared context/release per batch.
CPU_work_retained: Display-list decode and matrix/material/texture/light state updates.
LOAD eligibility and source-pool checks, dirty control writes, start/completion handling, alias cache invalidation.
Full eight-word raw-result readback and nine-word canonical vertex store per successful LOAD; packed int16 UVs are still converted to float.
Exact per-triangle clip rejection and CPU floating-point culling/cross products.
Material/alpha eligibility, W/clip tests, stale-slot masks, job construction, bounded run splitting, compatibility/fallback selection.
Import supported-range scans, claim/status/token MMIO and command publication; CPU preparation remains for rejected claims, older partial-LOAD slots and unsupported materials.
Game logic, texture management, clipping/fog fallback, audio and other frame work.
GPU_work_retained: Existing reciprocal/projection path, triangle setup, raster traversal and fragment/depth/color work.
Importer itself adds synchronous snapshot reads and format conversion before reusing existing projection.
decoupling_result: Snapshotv1/v2 application counters record zero raw-copy wait entries and polls. GPU-held snapshots no longer serialize the next raw LOAD.

bounded_budget.interpretation: Only an optimistic local removal budget if all other timing stayed unchanged. Function retirement-gap attribution is observational and is not a causal wall-time speedup bound. No FPS claim.
bounded_budget.indexed_run_caveat: Includes cull, material, tracking and preparation. Quantization is inlined and not separately isolated, so the whole bucket cannot be called removable conversion.

larger_architecture_requirement: Removing canonical readback requires exact cull metadata and a lazy fallback/lifetime design for fog, clipping, material changes and surviving partial LOAD slots. Keeping snapshots alive for those CPU consumers could reintroduce bank pressure. It is a separate design, not deleting the current copy call.
